newsitem.title: FRANCE: French police detain 111 people in child-porn probe.
newsitem.headline: French police detain 111 people in child-porn probe.

text.p: Police across France detained 111 people including five schoolteachers and seized more than 4,000 videos on Wednesday in an investigation into child-pornography films, investigators said.
They said some 600 gendarmes took part in the operation in 58 different areas, ordered by an investigating magistrate in the Riviera capital of Nice.

Three people had previously been detained in the probe in January and searches of their homes had enabled investigators to draw up a list of suspected clients, who bought videos via a telephone link-up system.
